item.title: Claudster 1.5.7
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.7

  • In-app updates with Sparkle: a daily check of claudster.dev/appcast.xml, Check for Updates… in the menu and Settings, EdDSA-signed DMGs; release.sh signs each DMG and adds it to the feed
  • Welcome guide's last page shows the real menu bar icon: Claudster's face in the chosen style, the orange dot and the count
  • Mac welcome guide looks like the iPhone onboarding: cream paper, a Claudster clip on every page (cut after the 4 s wake-up, keyed to the page, with sound and a mute button), accent footer; Return installs on step 1
  • Recording notes: transcribe with SpeechTranscriber, which hears real microphone recordings that DictationTranscriber returned nothing for
  • Screen recordings: optional microphone, clicks drawn in, and notes for Claude (transcript with times, click timeline)
  • The puck sits on the dashboard's top edge while it's open; its ring splits red and orange by count
  • Puck: hand cursors that work while Claudster is in the background; a shorter high five
  • Keep on top: orange and filled when on
  • Puck: open hand on hover, closed hand while dragging
  • Puck hover: a quick close-up of the high-five palm; click opens at once; arrow cursor
  • Puck: the high five on hover and click; no see-through blink; glow only when what needs you changes
